name: DOMINICA

flag.title: Sisserou Flag
flag.note: One of only 2 flags with purple colour

lead: Dominica is a tiny volcanic island in the Caribbean, covered in rainforest. People call it the "Nature Isle". It has 365 rivers, nine active volcanoes and a Boiling Lake in just 750 km².

sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: Nine active volcanoes rise from the rainforest, so thick that early settlers could barely land. More than 365 rivers cut through the mountains.
Morne Trois Pitons National Park hides the Boiling Lake, a 60-metre fumarole (steam vent) of grey-blue water. Black-sand beaches line the wild Atlantic coast.
animals: The Sisserou parrot has a purple chest and lives nowhere else on Earth. It is on the national flag. Only about 50 mature birds survive in the wild.
Sperm whales live in Dominica's warm waters all year. It is the only country where this is true.
culture: Dominica blends African, French and Kalinago roots. About 3,000 Kalinago live on the east coast. They are the Eastern Caribbean's last people from before Columbus.
People speak Kwéyòl (French Creole) beside English. Each October, Creole Day fills streets with madras cloth. Carnival, called 'The Real Mas', bursts with calypso music and costumes.
history: Columbus saw Dominica on a Sunday in 1493. 'Domingo' is Spanish for Sunday, which gave the island its name. The Kalinago fought settlers hard. Britain took control in 1763.

In 1838, it became the only British Caribbean colony with a Black-controlled law-making council. Independence came on 3 November 1978. After Hurricane Maria in 2017, it pledged to be the world's first nation ready for climate change.
wows: Dominica is the only country where sperm whales live offshore all year.
The island packs 365+ rivers into 750 km², one of the most river-filled places on Earth.
Dominica's flag is one of only two national flags in the world with purple.
The island's first people, the Kalinago, resisted so well that it was the last Caribbean island settled.
In 1838, Dominica had a Black-majority law-making council, the only one in the British Caribbean.
The Waitukubuli Trail is the Caribbean's first long-distance hiking path, 183 km long.
The Boiling Lake is Earth's second-largest flooded fumarole (steam vent).

myths.fact: They are two countries about 600 miles apart. Dominica speaks English. The Dominican Republic speaks Spanish.
Whales are mammals. They breathe air and feed their calves milk.
